title: [P2] Aspirational config — prune or mark experimental
body:
Part of the metadata liveness audit umbrella #1878 (P2 — spec hygiene, cluster #4).

## Problem
**Aspirational config — rich spec, zero runtime.** These properties parse but have no consumer. Each should be either pruned from the spec or explicitly marked `experimental` so authors know it does nothing yet.

## Checklist
- [ ] field: enhanced-type configs (barcode / qr / slider / rating / color / location) + governance (encryption / masking / audit / dataQuality)
- [ ] object: `enable` / versioning / partitioning / cdc / softDelete / search
- [ ] agent: autonomy (memory / guardrails / structuredOutput / lifecycle) — **except** `planning.maxIterations` (live)
- [ ] tool: `outputSchema`
- [ ] job: `retryPolicy` / `timeout`
- [ ] theme: `spacing` / `breakpoints` / `logo` / `rtl` / `density` (and touchTarget)
- [ ] translation: `messageFormat: 'icu'` (no ICU engine), `supportedLocales`, `cache`
- [ ] webhook: non-HMAC auth
- [ ] **PortalSchema (entire)** — not registered, no route, no renderer (100% dead)

## Evidence
- `docs/audits/README.md` cluster #4, plus per-type reports.
